tasks.short: Help operators resolve problems running programs

steps.what: Report problems running the computer programs
Read running problems on the program log
Consult analysts to define and resolve problems
Note the resolve path without changing programs
Confirm the programs are running again

tasks.design: The systems administrator opens a {HELPDESK} ticket with program id, symptom and when the programs stopped running. The computer programmer reads the run on {BI}, then consults to define and resolve the problem. A short note in {DOCS} records the path. The note does not change a live system. The administrator confirms whether the programs are running again.
tasks.previous_blocker: Symptoms arrived as chat lines with no program id, so a later note could not show which run it referred to.
tasks.enabler_now: The ticket can require program id and a start time, and the run log can be opened from that id.
tasks.still_hard: Defining the problem with the people who saw it, and judging a fix that would touch a live system, stay human. This task does not apply that fix.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides what the running problem actually is, and stops short of an unattended change.

ambition.what: File the agreed path the same day, while the failing run is still available

tasks.altitude: Less time reconstructing the symptom from chat. The conversation stays, and the programmer can refuse to treat the note as a live change.

reach.task: Confirm the programs are running, or open a separate change
reach.learn: Which problems are explained and which still need a signed change

evidence.claim: Helping an operator with a running program is a conversation plus a look at the log. The log can be opened from a ticket. The diagnosis cannot.
Digest [S28] describes a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so this task records a path and does not write to a live system.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends at a signed note and the administrator's confirmation. Applying a fix is a different task.
Input contract: program id, symptom, start time, environment. Producer is the systems administrator. If program id is missing, the ticket waits and no note is drafted.
Use the helpdesk form and the existing run view before custom code. The meeting share fits this task. The design does not watch staff. It reads the program run.
unknowns: Which runs are kept long enough to read the next day.
Who confirms when the administrator is off shift.
Whether some problems are only visible on a live console.
research_questions: What share of running problems have a program id on the first ticket?
How often does the signed note say the cause is outside the program?

already_counted.description: Reading an odd run stays with the programmer
The consult to resolve the problem stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Keep the ticket fields aligned when a new environment is added

approvals.approved_version: path note signed for this ticket id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes tickets stay free text, so the programmer still hunts the run and the meeting is unchanged. The high case assumes the log opens from the ticket, but the consult and the note stay manual. No live change is counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read systems analysis notes for this software
Draft a programming change for systems tasks

loop.output: a change that cites only those fields
loop.check: The draft names the software id and the rollback
loop.stop: One pass; stop if rollback is empty
loop.why_not_simpler: Control of systems software is not a fixed edit

steps.what: Maintain the systems software by hand
Scan the programming change for known flaws
Decide control of the computer systems software

tasks.design: A change record on {PROJECT} names the systems software, the programming task and a rollback. A bounded draft proposes a change from those fields. The computer programmer maintains the software by hand. A {DATA_PLATFORM} scan reports known flaws for the programmer to read. The scan does not apply a fix. The programmer signs a version. No unattended write reaches the live system.
tasks.previous_blocker: Systems-software changes were console notes, so a draft could not tell a control change from a guess.
tasks.enabler_now: The change record can require software id, task and rollback before a draft or a scan runs.
tasks.still_hard: Control of computer systems software, and whether a flaw report is a real risk here, remain the programmer's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides the change and refuses any path that would apply it unattended.

ambition.what: Review systems-software exceptions every month, not only after an outage

tasks.altitude: Routine flaw lists take less collecting. The programmer still maintains the software and can block an unsigned change.

reach.task: Schedule a window if the signed version must be placed later
reach.learn: Which version is signed and that the scan did not apply a fix

evidence.claim: Maintaining systems software in a mid-size firm is careful editing plus a review. Very little of it is safe to run unattended on the live system.
Digest [S4] says a coding assistant needs a person to review, so a drafted systems change stays a proposal.
Digest [S6] describes scanning code with a reviewed fix. Here the scan only reports flaws. The fix is not applied by the scan.
Digest [S28] describes a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so unattended writes to live systems are out of this task.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer, acting as the person who maintains systems software. Placing the version onto a live machine is not this task.
Input contract: software id, programming task, reason, rollback, environment. Producer is the computer programmer or the systems administrator on the change record. Missing rollback stops the draft.
Use the existing change record and the scanner's report before custom code. The meeting prior overstates this task. Time today is on the software, the scan and the decision.
The scan has no write authority. A clean scan is not proof the change is correct.
unknowns: Which systems software has no safe copy to edit.
Who may sign when the programmer is absent.
Whether a flaw feed already exists.
research_questions: What share of systems changes have a written rollback?
How often does the programmer reject a flaw the scan reported?

already_counted.description: Programmer reworks the systems draft before editing
Hand maintenance of systems software stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Update the flaw rules when a new class of systems software is in scope

approvals.approved_version: systems software version signed after this flaw report

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes most changes have no rollback text, so the draft and the scan do not run and the programmer still works from the console. The high case assumes a report, but maintaining the software and the signature stay manual. No live placement is counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write manuals that guide end users

steps.what: List user tasks the manuals must guide
Draft instructions or manuals from those tasks

loop.input: user task names and program id
loop.output: manual steps that cite those tasks
loop.check: Every step cites a task name on the brief
loop.stop: One pass; drop a step that cites no task
loop.why_not_simpler: The words a user needs are not a fixed sentence per task

steps.what: Rewrite the manuals where a step is missing
Sign the manual version for end users
Publish the signed manuals where users read

tasks.design: A system user lists the tasks the manual must cover on a {WORKFLOW} form, with program id and audience. A bounded draft writes instructions in {DOCS} from those tasks only. The computer programmer rewrites missing steps, signs one version, and that version is published for users. A drafted step is not treated as correct until the programmer signs it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manuals were rewritten from an old file, so steps referred to screens the program no longer had.
tasks.enabler_now: The form can tie each user task to a program id, so a draft step with no task can be dropped.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a user can follow the step without the programmer beside them is still a judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides the manuals are safe to hand to users for this program version.

ambition.what: Staff who use the program only occasionally can follow the manual without booking the programmer

tasks.altitude: Less rewriting of unchanged steps. The programmer still signs the manual and can leave a step blank.

reach.task: Follow the signed manual for one program version
reach.learn: Which tasks are covered and which the programmer left for a person to explain

evidence.claim: End-user manuals in a mid-size firm are documents. A first draft can follow a task list. The steps a user cannot follow are found by a person.
A drafted manual can omit a branch a user will hit. Model knowledge: the omission is common when the source is only a task name, so a person still rewrites.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends when a signed manual version is published to the document store. Training sessions are a different task.
Input contract: program id, user task name, audience, screen name. Producer is the system user or the software developer. A task with no program id is not drafted.
Use the document template before custom code. The meeting prior overstates this task. Time today is on the manual. Publishing is a file copy of the signed version, not a code deploy.
unknowns: Which programs have no current manual.
Who may sign when the programmer is absent.
Whether screenshots are required or forbidden.
research_questions: What share of user tasks are named on the form before drafting starts?
How often does a user still call after the signed manual is published?

already_counted.description: Signing the manual stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Revise the manual template when a program gains a new task type
Users correct task names the form rejects

approvals.approved_version: manual version signed for this program id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes task lists stay vague, so the programmer still writes the manual by hand. The high case assumes a draft from clean tasks, but rewriting and the signature stay. User reading time is not counted as the programmer's saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Investigate networks and equipment responding to a program

steps.what: Investigate whether the program is responding
Check networks and workstations for a response
Check peripheral equipment and the central processing path
Compare program instructions with what ran
Write which part failed to follow instructions
Confirm the equipment reading from their console

tasks.design: A {HELPDESK} ticket names the program and the failed run. The computer programmer investigates on {BI} whether the program is responding, then checks networks, workstations and peripheral equipment with the systems administrator's {OPS_SYSTEM} view. The finding is written in {DOCS}. It does not change the network or the equipment. A green console light is not the finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Failure notes did not say whether the program, the network or the equipment stopped, so each investigation started from scratch.
tasks.enabler_now: The ticket can name program id, and the operations view can show whether a workstation or a device answered.
tasks.still_hard: Odd paths, and deciding that the program's instructions were or were not followed, stay with the programmer.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides which part failed to follow the program's instructions, and does not apply a fix from this task.

ambition.what: Record which part failed the same day, before the run detail rolls off

tasks.altitude: Less time asking who saw the failure. The programmer still walks the path and can refuse a guess.

reach.task: Check the equipment named in the finding
reach.learn: Whether the programmer blamed the program, the network or the equipment

evidence.claim: This investigation is reading a run and checking whether networks or equipment answered. The split between program and machine is a judgement.
Digest [S28] describes a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so this task writes a finding and does not change live equipment.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends at a signed finding. Repairing the network or the program is a different task.
Input contract: program id, run id, workstation id, symptom, time. Producer is the system user via the helpdesk. Missing program id keeps the ticket on a manual list.
Use the existing operations view before custom probes. Part of the meeting prior is real, because the programmer asks the administrator. The bulk is the console, not a workshop.
The finding authorises no live change.
unknowns: Which devices expose a status the programmer can read.
How long run detail is kept.
Who writes the finding when the programmer is absent.
research_questions: What share of these tickets are equipment rather than the program?
How often is the first finding revised the next day?

already_counted.description: Checking networks and workstations stays with the programmer
Comparing instructions with the run stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Add a device type to the finding template when it appears twice

approvals.approved_version: finding signed for this run id

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes status is not on a view, so the programmer still investigates by hand and by asking. The high case assumes the views open from the ticket, but the checks and the finding stay manual. No repair is counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week still includes hard running problems and systems software. Less time goes into rewriting user manuals from scratch, and a written finding exists before anyone touches equipment.
reach: Systems administrators receive the signed finding and the systems-software version, and any live change stays a separate human act.
System users can open the signed manual for the program version they run.
skills_to_grow: Separate a program fault from a network or equipment fault.
Refuse an unattended change to systems software.
Write a manual step a user can follow without the programmer in the room.
role.ambitious_version: User manuals stay tied to the program version, and no systems-software change is applied from an unsigned draft.
